# x402 Phonetic Encoder

> Soundex (classic) + lightweight Metaphone-style phonetic keys for fuzzy name and entity matching. Deterministic. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/encode – service info
- POST /api/encode – paid encoding

## Pricing

~0.003 – 0.007 USDC per call (default max 0.007 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "text": ["Smith", "Smythe", "Schmidt"],
  "options": {
    "algorithms": ["soundex", "metaphone"]
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "results": [
    { "input": "Smith", "soundex": "S530", "metaphone": "SM0" },
    { "input": "Smythe", "soundex": "S530", "metaphone": "SM0" },
    { "input": "Schmidt", "soundex": "S530", "metaphone": "XMT" }
  ],
  "meta": { "count": 3, "algorithms": ["soundex", "metaphone"] }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents resolving people / entities across datasets, CRM deduplication, or building phonetic search indexes without exact spelling.
